subject: MSA & Order Form — DPA/SCCs: transfer evidence and delegation clarifications
messages:
From: Sarah White <sarah.white@greenlinehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Patel <m.patel@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Questions on DPA / SCCs in MSA + Order Form (GH-2234)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for sending over the draft MSA and order form. Our legal team reviewed the DPA exhibit and had a few open items we need to clarify before we move to procurement signoff: 

- Delegation of controller/processor responsibilities: the current draft references a delegate model but does not map services to the processor roster. We need an explicit mapping for EU-hosted processing and any on-call transfer pathways.
- SCCs placement: can you confirm whether Redwood intends to incorporate the new EU SCCs as an exhibit or inline clauses? Our counsel prefers exhibit insertion so we can reference versioning.
- Technical evidence: we will need SOC2 snapshot, key management details, and an encryption-at-rest statement for review.

I've attached a short TIA question list from our privacy counsel (Greenline_TIA_questions.pdf). Can your legal ops team confirm what evidence we can provide that ties to the Hosting/Region obligations in the order form? Also flag any potential need for a transfer impact addendum for UK-specific law.

Proposed next steps from our side: 30-minute call next week with legal + procurement to triage redlines and agree a timeline for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Sarah White
Head of Legal Ops
Greenline Health

Attachment: Greenline_TIA_questions.pdf
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sarah White <sarah.white@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA / SCCs in MSA + Order Form (GH-2234)

Sarah,

Appreciate the clear list — this is exactly the level of detail we need. I spoke to our legal ops and product infra; we can do the following:

1) Delegation matrix: attach a redline that includes a table mapping core services to processor status and subprocessor families (see Redwood_DPA_v2_redline.docx). That will explicitly call out EU-hosted endpoints, VPC/private deployments, and Dedicated pools.

2) SCCs approach: Redwood prefers to include the EU SCCs as an exhibit so we can update the exhibit if versions change. We will include the FULL text of the current SCCs as Exhibit C and add a short versioning clause in the DPA to tie to the exhibit.

3) Evidence: we can share a SOC2 snapshot, an exported KMS architecture diagram, and a short encryption statement. Attaching SOC2_Type2_snapshot.pdf; we will redact any customer-specific items.

Suggested timeline:
- Legal triage call: Wed 2027-04-13 14:00 CEST (30 minutes).
- We provide a consolidated redline + exhibit insertion after the call (target: 2027-04-15 EOD).
- DocuSign window: target week of 2027-04-19 after procurement signoff.

Ben, Laura — looping you in for legal/ops and commercial alignment. Laura, can you confirm the delegation matrix format is acceptable and whether we need a separate UK transfer addendum?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v2_redline.docx
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Sarah White <sarah.white@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA / SCCs in MSA + Order Form (GH-2234)

Neha / Sarah,

Forwarding a quick ops note and proposed delegation table layout — see inline.

On Mon, Apr 11, 2027 at 11:05 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sarah,
> 
> Appreciate the clear list — this is exactly the level of detail we need. I spoke to our legal ops and product infra; we can do the following:
> 
> 1) Delegation matrix: attach a redline that includes a table mapping core services to processor status and subprocessor families (see Redwood_DPA_v2_redline.docx). That will explicitly call out EU-hosted endpoints, VPC/private deployments, and Dedicated pools.

Proposed delegation table (high-level):
- Service family: Inference API (hosted) -> Processor: Redwood Inference (global) -> Subprocessors: GPU hosting partners, Cloud infra layer (region-specific)
- Service family: Dedicated/Private -> Processor: Redwood Inference (customer-controlled pool) -> Subprocessors: internal operations only, third-party monitoring in EU region (if enabled)

UK transfer addendum: recommendation is a short transfer-impact addendum (TIA) only if the customer requires additional UK-specific safeguards beyond SCCs. Given Greenline is an EU-headquartered healthcare provider, we should offer the TIA as an optional add-on and document it in the redline as Exhibit D. If counsel requests explicit UK KMS residency, that will be a separate commercial ask.

Technical evidence handoff: ops can share a SOC2 snapshot and a KMS diagram. We will include a single-page evidence index that lists items and redaction notes so procurement can accept the evidence without extra back-and-forth.

Laura Bennett
Senior Legal Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_Type2_snapshot.pdf
From: Sarah White <sarah.white@greenlinehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Patel <m.patel@greenlinehealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-14T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA / SCCs in MSA + Order Form (GH-2234)

Neha / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and proposed plan.

We can make Wed 2027-04-13 at 14:00 CEST work for a 30-min call; appreciate the exhibit-as-SCC approach. A couple of final asks before the call:

- Can Redwood confirm whether the DPA redline will explicitly call out the new SCCs version and include a replacement/upgrade mechanism if regulators issue an update? We need to show procurement that clause exists.
- Evidence acceptance: procurement will accept the SOC2 snapshot only if the evidence index lists the SOC2 period and the certifying auditor. Please include that in the index and note any redactions.
- DocuSign timing: procurement would prefer execution by 2027-04-20. If the redline + evidence index is delivered on 2027-04-15 as proposed, that timeline should work.

If we get the redline with the delegation table and evidence index, procurement will begin internal approvals the same day. Looking forward to the call.

Regards,
Sarah White
Head of Legal Ops
Greenline Health

Attachment: none
